messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Dan at FinServCorp asked for 'logchain' evidence for vendor risk review — SIEM ingestion, retention, admin activity audit. Wants POC timeline + artifacts by Wed. Any objections to sharing sample exports?
ajay_se: We can share anonymized SIEM exports, retention policy, and proof-of-playback logs. Need to confirm retention window they require (90/365 days?) and whether they need immutable archival.
dan_customer: Prefer 365 for compliance, but 90 is minimum. Need admin activity trails with user/account IDs and SSO context. Also want ingestion latency SLAs.
lucy_security: We can't share raw customer logs. We can provide synthetic/exported artifacts that mirror schema + a signed checksum + audit trail of the export process. We'll also provide CAIQ snippets for control mappings. Example artifact names: `logchain_export_2026-03-20_{redacted}.json.gz`
tina_infra: Our current retention: 90 days hot in SIEM, 1yr cold on S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Admin actions are stored for 2 yrs in the audit-store. Can produce expirable S3 presigned URL for POC export. ACLs: KMS-encrypted, access logged.
ajay_se: For SIEM ingestion, we support Splunk (HEC), Elastic, and generic syslog over TLS. Sample ingestion record + mapping below:
```
{ "timestamp":"2026-03-20T12:00:00Z", "source":"inference-service-01", "event":"admin_config_change", "user":"redwood\\:se-prod" }
```
Can embed user-SSO context fields.
lucy_security: I'll draft one-page control evidence mapping to SIG A2/A3 (logging/monitoring) and include screenshots of console audit UI with redacted IDs. Also include export SHA256 checksums and a short playbook for reproducing exports.
maria_sales: Timeline: SE artifacts by Tue EOD, Security mapping by Wed morning, POC export link by Wed afternoon. Dan — does that meet your audit deadline?
dan_customer: :thumbsup: That's tight but workable. Also need pricing impact—does enabling 1yr cold storage change Dedicated pricing?
tina_infra: Short answer: yes, storage + retrieval costs apply. I'll add estimated burn: ~$X/month per TB cold + retrieval cost if accessed. We'll include a pricing appendix.
ajay_se: I'll attach an anonymized sample payload and `logchain_playback.sh` snippet in the PR. Anyone want to add extra checks we should include?
lucy_security: Add evidence of RBAC changes and KMS key rotation logs. Also mention retention SLA and deletion playbook for data subject requests.
maria_sales: Thanks team — I'll update Dan after we upload artifacts. Will ping once assets are live. @dan_customer feel free to DM for any urgent items.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: export_job_3921 completed: `logchain_export_2026-03-20_redacted.json.gz` uploaded to `s3://redwood-poc-exports/finserv/` (encrypted).
